_source: Stage 7 (Claude Code, 08.10): the shape of lexicon §5.22 „menus.json”. One menu `eindejaar-2026`, opened in the bestelbon by `?menu=` + its `param`; `deadline` ISO date or null → [DATUM]; `pickup` = the two days the plan assumes (24 and 31 December, build plan row 7 — B 3 / B 11 confirm them), `from`/`to` null → [UUR] and the day's opening hours in the bestelbon; `items` = the board's seven stand-in rows (§5.22 table), `price` null → [PRIJS] (Gourmet 9's €10 on the board is the old site's price, FACTS — not used), `unit` kg | pers | stuk (gourmet 9 and luxe: min 2 persons, as gourmet-9 in products.json); `message` = lexicon §5.10 eindejaar without its dots — the bestelbon puts the order after it (§5.22 „the bestelbon fills the dots”); `pickupOnly` = the line the bestelbon shows when a menu row is chosen (menu orders are pickup only — §5.22 „Answers to Claude Code's stage-7 report”, 08.10 17:50; RO kept for stage 9); `mail` = the menu's word in the shop's mail (subject NL „Bestelling {REF} · Eindejaarsmenu · afhalen …”, first line RO „… · meniul de sărbători · ridicare …”, same source). The rows have the products.json shape so the bestelbon lists them under „Eindejaarsmenu 2026” (/bestellen?menu=eindejaar). The owners' folder replaces the rows wholesale (B 11); Cowork fills this file at stage 15.

message.nl: Dag, ik wil bestellen uit het eindejaarsmenu:
message.ro: Bună, vreau să comand din meniul de sărbători:

pickupOnly.nl: Het eindejaarsmenu haalt u af in de winkel, op 24 of 31 december.
pickupOnly.ro: Meniul de sărbători se ridică din magazin, pe 24 sau 31 decembrie.
